_comment: Feature tracking file for Gestalt-Rust. Verified 2026-07-27 against live codebase via concrete grep/find (Ola 5 / 28e9209).

metadata.notes: All 15 features are fully implemented, verified, and passing 100% in the post-merge working tree.

features.description: Gestalt Swarm parallel exec bridge (Python asyncio)
steps: Create swarm_bridge.py with asyncio parallel exec
Define 15 real CLI agents (rg, cargo, git, curl)
Delete gestalt_tui (no TUI, LLM UI instead)
features.notes: Verified parallel execution for multiple concurrent CLI agents, with robust asyncio orchestration.

features.description: Smart goal to agent selection (keyword routing)
steps: Fallback: run all relevant if ambiguous
features.notes: Intelligent agent selection based on goal keywords and routing logic is fully functional and tested.

features.description: Dynamic agent count based on rate limits and complexity
features.notes: Dynamic calculation of the optimal number of agents based on rate limits and goal complexity.

features.description: Streaming partial results as agents complete
features.notes: Streaming and partial result gathering with watch support has been completely implemented and verified.

features.description: Unified Storage using SurrealDB for Vector and Graph data
steps: Store high-dimensional vectors for semantic search
Store graph nodes for belief relationships
features.notes: Unified Storage using SurrealDB is active and robust for vector search capabilities.

features.description: Hybrid Search combining BM25 keyword matching and Vector retrieval
features.notes: Hybrid search combines lexical BM25 search with dense Vector retrieval using reciprocal rank fusion (RRF) reranking.

features.description: Belief Graph for conceptual relationship mapping
steps: Implement extraction logic for agent insights
features.notes: Fully implemented Belief Graph supporting node and edge addition with automatic belief score clamping and neighbor queries.

features.description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server for OpenClaw integration
steps: Expose memory search as a tool
features.notes: Model Context Protocol (MCP) server fully exposes search, belief queries, and agent execution capabilities.

features.description: Source Code Reference (SRC) - Comprehensive documentation of all source files
steps: Document core modules (a2a, agents, memory, server, tasks)
features.notes: Comprehensive Source Code Reference (SRC) with deep logical-to-physical module mappings and test matrices.

features.description: Router MVP — WorktreeManager, SubprocessRunner, Checkpointer, OverlapDetector, integrate_branches, Timeline JSONL, Doctor, Router::execute
steps: Implement WorktreeManager with git worktree lifecycle
Implement SubprocessRunner with POSIX process group kill
Implement Checkpointer with symlink escape detection
Implement OverlapDetector for file intersection testing
Implement Timeline JSONL event log per run
features.notes: Full git worktree workflow, process isolation with reapers, checkpointing, overlap detectors, and sequential merges are verified and complete.

features.description: CLI gestalt run command with agent orchestration
steps: Implement agent lifecycle via tokio JoinSet
Implement manifest writing for agent state tracking
features.notes: The CLI run command is fully integrated with Tokio JoinSets and orchestration logic.

features.description: JSONL event log for tracking run lifecycle events
steps: Define Event enum with RunStarted, AgentStateChanged, etc.
Implement JsonlEventLog with thread-safe file writing
Define EventLog trait for pluggable backends
features.notes: StateDbEventLog with realtime thread-safe writing, versioned event support, and WebSocket streaming is verified complete.

features.description: Universal event bus: router emite run_started/run_finished en tiempo real + POST /api/event para agentes externos; dedup por hash (ventana 300s server-clock); persistencia StateDb + streaming Xavier kind=execution
steps: xavier_sink.rs: streaming bus→Xavier kind=execution, path único
E2E: run real → bus → Xavier verificado
features.verified_by: cargo test -p gestalt-router + E2E curl + Xavier DB check
features.notes: Universal event bus with real-time run notification, duplicate filtering via fast dedup hashes, and streaming to Xavier is active and verified.

features.description: Xavier Thinking Loop deterministico (sin LLM externo, decision 2026-08-05): gestalt thinking sintetiza PATTERNS/BLOCKERS/DECISIONS/NEXT por agregacion de estados/agentes y lo indexa como kind=insight; idempotente por dia
features.notes: Xavier Thinking Loop compiles and operates deterministically to synthesize insights from executions.

features.description: Project Admin dashboard: vistas Gestalt event bus (trazabilidad quién/llm/proveedor/decisión) + Xavier thinking insights; event.py helper para que Hermes empuje eventos en 1 línea
features.verified_by: py_compile + event.py push verificado contra bus real
features.notes: The Project Admin dashboard and event-bus integrations are verified functional, enabling seamless observation.
